relations.quote: The padded transform box is the array of a [Multidimensional transform](multidimensional-transform.md) over its $D$ padded axes: the full array of entries that results once every axis has been padded to its chosen length.

The padded transform box is rearranged by the coordinate permutations of the [Transform identity with retained permutations](transform-identity.md), which move entries within this one fixed array instead of sorting the data into a new array.

The padded transform box is built from the [radix-digit coefficients](radix-digit-convolution.md) of the two integers, placed on pairwise coprime valid lengths $W_1,\dots,W_D$ by a [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md) $\Phi$.
Expanding axis $s$ updates the box along each [line](axis-line.md) whose other coordinates are valid.

symbols.name: box address
symbols.meaning: An address naming one entry of the box, with axis coordinates $x_1,\dots,x_D$.
symbols.quote: An address $\mathbf{x} = (x_1,\dots,x_D)$ with $0 \le x_s < t_s$ for every $s$ names one entry of the box.

symbols.name: valid length
symbols.meaning: The number of data entries along axis $s$, the valid length of that axis.
symbols.quote: For each axis $s$, running from $1$ to $D$, let $W_s$ be the valid length, the number of data entries along that axis, and let $t_s \ge W_s$ be its padded length.

symbols.name: axis forward map
symbols.meaning: The one-dimensional forward map of axis $s$, from length-$W_s$ to length-$t_s$ vectors.
symbols.quote: It applies the one-dimensional forward map $A_s$ to each such line, from length-$W_s$ to length-$t_s$ vectors:

symbols.name: axis backward map
symbols.meaning: The one-dimensional backward map of axis $s$, from length-$t_s$ to length-$W_s$ vectors.
symbols.quote: Compressing axis $s$ instead applies the backward map $B_{0,s}$, from length-$t_s$ to length-$W_s$ vectors, to each line whose other coordinates are valid, writes its $W_s$ outputs followed by $t_s - W_s$ zeros, and writes a zero line on every other line.
